verdict.rationale: Airwallex supports event-driven automation via webhooks (real-time push notifications with retry/dedupe semantics) and AgentOS/CLI/MCP tooling that lets agents run multi-step workflows, but there is no documented user-facing 'rules engine' where an AI-native user declaratively defines trigger-condition-action rules — automation still requires building a webhook consumer or scripting agent workflows rather than configuring rules in-product. missing for 10: a native rules/automation builder (event + condition + action) exposed via API or UI, and independent evidence of such rule-based automation actually firing in production.
